'''Assimara Cows''' are the [[:Category:Assimara_Parasites|Assimara Version]] of Cows.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns individually, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] onward, with a spawnweight of 1, once 4 Cows have been assimilated.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimara Cows are Utility, Short Ranged Combatants.
*Their melee attack is performed through contact damage, but they will not attempt to do this.
*Assimara Cows will slowly approach their target and then vomit purple particles and produce a green effect cloud Infront of them. This attack has a 12 second cooldown.
**This effect cloud inflicts, [[Viral]], Wither, Weakness, Hunger, and the [[Vomit]] effect, which covers your screen in a magenta splash. All of these effects are inflicted for 15 seconds.
*Any mob within 3 blocks of an Assimara Cow will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive]]. This does not go through walls.
*Assimara Cows are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
*Assimara Cows are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On death Assimara Cows have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimara Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Assimara Cows, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
